# BS Works — Birinder Singh (Freelance Web Developer in Patiala, Punjab, India)

> BS Works (https://www.bsworks.store/) is the independent web design and development studio of Birinder Singh, a freelance web developer and ecommerce specialist based in Patiala, Punjab, India. BS Works builds custom Shopify stores, Shopify Liquid OS 2.0 theme customizations, WordPress & Elementor websites, custom WordPress plugins, and WooCommerce online stores for businesses in Patiala, Mohali, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Rajpura, across India, and remotely for clients in Canada and Australia.

## Web Development & Ecommerce Services
- [Custom Website Design & Responsive UI/UX in Patiala](https://www.bsworks.store/services/website-design/): Hand-coded HTML5/CSS3/JS/Bootstrap and WordPress business websites and landing pages.
- [Freelance Shopify Developer in Patiala & Worldwide](https://www.bsworks.store/services/shopify-development/): End-to-end Shopify store setup, collection architecture, responsive storefront design, and app configuration.
- [Shopify Liquid Theme Customization & Custom OS 2.0 Sections](https://www.bsworks.store/services/shopify-theme-customization/): Custom Liquid sections, JSON templates, theme editor controls, layout bug fixes, and speed cleanup.
- [Freelance WordPress Developer in Patiala & Custom Elementor Builds](https://www.bsworks.store/services/wordpress-development/): Manageable WordPress and Elementor business sites plus custom PHP/MySQL WordPress plugin development.
- [WooCommerce Store Development in Patiala & India](https://www.bsworks.store/services/woocommerce-development/): Self-hosted WordPress ecommerce stores, custom product/department layouts, and checkout customization.
- [Website Speed Optimization Services & Maintenance](https://www.bsworks.store/services/website-maintenance/): Core Web Vitals optimization, leftover app/plugin cleanup, bug fixes, and ongoing care.
- [Technical SEO Services & On-Page Optimization in Patiala](https://www.bsworks.store/services/seo-services/): Keyword-to-page mapping, semantic headings, JSON-LD structured data, XML sitemaps, and local SEO signals.
